title: UI风格#100 - Parisian Art Nouveau (巴黎新艺术)
description: 创建第100种UI风格：巴黎新艺术风格 - 埃菲尔铁塔、美好时代、沙龙氛围。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planCV.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Parisian Art Nouveau style When color palette Then features champagne gold, powder pink, slate blue, ivory cream
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#F7E7CE (香槟金), #FFB6C1 (粉彩), #6A7B8B (石板蓝), #FFFFF0 (象牙白), #2F2F2F (石墨)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Parisian Art Nouveau style When typography Then uses elegant parisian: Playfair Display, Cormorant, or Didot
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Playfair Display (标题), Cormorant (正文), Didot (装饰)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Parisian Art Nouveau style When layout Then elegant asymmetry, salon composition, wrought iron patterns
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：优雅不对称、沙龙构图、铁艺图案、花卉装饰

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Parisian Art Nouveau style When UI elements Then iron scrollwork, floral ornaments, velvet textures
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：铁艺卷饰、花卉装饰、丝绒质感、优雅过渡

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Parisian Art Nouveau UI When functional Then includes salon chat, artist agents, gallery stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：沙龙聊天、艺术家代理、画廊统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Parisian Art Nouveau UI When copy Then uses belle époque: 'Salon', 'Élan', 'Charleston', 'Gentrile'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'SALON. ÉLAN. CHARLESTON.'、按钮'SEND'→'DANSER'、'SUBMIT'→'CÉLÉBRER'
